name: RiskMatrix
tagline: Risk Matrix turns two simple number (or Choice) columns, Likelihood and Impact, into an interactive heat map.
description: Risk Matrix turns two simple number (or Choice) columns, Likelihood and Impact, into an interactive heat map. Users click the cell where the likelihood meets the impact and the control works out the risk score and risk band (for example Low, Medium, High, Critical) straight away.
features: Risk appetite and escalation rules, keyboard grid
Phone pickers and score / band / escalation outputs
